name: dispatch
description: Flash Role Guard: central dispatch interceptor enforcing the DeepSeek Flash/Pro model routing policy with auto-redirect and guard logging

capabilities.name: dispatch.guard
capabilities.description: Resolve the allowed model per task type, enforce the Flash allowlist/forbidden list, and provide a safe call_flash() that auto-redirects forbidden tasks to Pro (guard.py)

credentials.description: DeepSeek API key consumed by call_flash(); not required for policy resolution (resolve_model / check_task_allowed)

storage.description: No persistent storage; _runtime/dispatch/guard_log.jsonl is a best-effort runtime side-effect, not module state
